techStack.title: Tech Stack
techStack.summary: My professional toolkit includes a robust blend of frontend, backend, and database technologies, complemented by essential development tools and strong language proficiencies.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.description: Proficient in modern web development, building interactive user interfaces with React and leveraging Progressive Web App capabilities for enhanced user experience.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Experienced in server-side development with Node.js and Express.js, utilizing Sequelize CLI for efficient database schema management and ORM.

database.title: Database
database.description: Skilled in relational database management with MySQL, ensuring data integrity and efficient querying for robust applications.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Adept at version control with Git, project management and documentation with Notion, and team collaboration through Slack.

language.title: Language
language.description: Fluent in English with 7 years of residency in the US, enabling seamless technical documentation comprehension and international collaboration. Basic Japanese and native Korean speaker.
